parameters.query:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT id, doc_no, file_name, file_type, category, status, source, size_bytes, chunk_count, line_user_id, uploaded_at, updated_at, error_message
  FROM law.contracts c
  WHERE (($1::text IS NULL OR $1 = '')
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(file_name,'')) LIKE '%' || LOWER($1) || '%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(category,'')) LIKE '%' || LOWER($1) || '%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(source,'')) LIKE '%' || LOWER($1) || '%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(doc_no,'')) LIKE '%' || LOWER($1) || '%')
    AND ($2::text IS NULL OR $2 = '' OR status = $2)
  ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC
  LIMIT $3::int OFFSET $4::int
) real
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL::uuid, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM law.contracts)
ORDER BY 1 NULLS LAST

SELECT c.id, c.doc_no, c.file_name, c.file_type, c.category, c.status, c.source, c.size_bytes, c.chunk_count, c.line_user_id, c.line_group_id, c.line_message_id, c.uploaded_at, c.updated_at, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', ch.id, 'chunk_index', ch.chunk_index, 'preview', LEFT(ch.content, 200), 'token_count', ch.token_count) ORDER BY ch.chunk_index) FROM law.contract_chunks ch WHERE ch.contract_id = c.id) AS chunks FROM law.contracts c WHERE c.id = $1::uuid

UPDATE law.contracts SET file_name = COALESCE(NULLIF($2, ''), file_name), category = NULLIF($3, ''), source = NULLIF($4, ''), status = COALESCE(NULLIF($5, ''), status), updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id, doc_no, file_name, file_type, category, status, source, size_bytes, chunk_count, line_user_id, uploaded_at, updated_at

DELETE FROM law.contracts
WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING id, file_name, storage_bucket, storage_path,
  CASE 
    WHEN storage_path LIKE 'http%' AND storage_path LIKE '%/' || storage_bucket || '/%'
    THEN split_part(storage_path, '/' || storage_bucket || '/', 2)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS minio_key;

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM law.contracts) AS total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM law.contracts WHERE status='ready') AS ready, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM law.contracts WHERE status='pending') AS pending, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM law.contracts WHERE status='failed') AS failed

SELECT id, file_name, file_type,
  COALESCE(
    file_mime,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(COALESCE(file_type, '')) = 'pdf' THEN 'application/pdf'
      WHEN lower(COALESCE(file_type, '')) = 'png' THEN 'image/png'
      WHEN lower(COALESCE(file_type, '')) IN ('jpg', 'jpeg') THEN 'image/jpeg'
      WHEN lower(COALESCE(file_type, '')) = 'txt' THEN 'text/plain; charset=utf-8'
      ELSE 'application/octet-stream'
    END
  ) AS file_mime,
  encode(file_data, 'base64') AS file_data_b64,
  octet_length(file_data) AS file_size
FROM law.contracts
WHERE id = $1::uuid

WITH q AS (SELECT $1::vector AS qvec, $3::text AS qtxt),
v AS (
  SELECT ch.contract_id, ch.chunk_index, ch.content,
         1 - (ch.embedding <=> q.qvec) AS v_sim,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ch.embedding <=> q.qvec) AS v_rank
  FROM law.contract_chunks ch, q
  WHERE ch.embedding IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY ch.embedding <=> q.qvec
  LIMIT $2::int * 4
),
t AS (
  SELECT ch.contract_id, ch.chunk_index, ch.content,
         (CASE WHEN ch.content ILIKE '%' || q.qtxt || '%' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END)::float
         + (length(ch.content) - length(replace(lower(ch.content), lower(q.qtxt), '')))::float
           / greatest(length(q.qtxt), 1)::float * 0.1 AS t_sim,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY
           (CASE WHEN ch.content ILIKE '%' || q.qtxt || '%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),
           (length(ch.content) - length(replace(lower(ch.content), lower(q.qtxt), '')))::float DESC,
           ch.chunk_index ASC) AS t_rank
  FROM law.contract_chunks ch, q
  WHERE length(q.qtxt) > 0
  ORDER BY (CASE WHEN ch.content ILIKE '%' || q.qtxt || '%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),
           (length(ch.content) - length(replace(lower(ch.content), lower(q.qtxt), '')))::float DESC
  LIMIT $2::int * 4
),
fused AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(v.contract_id, t.contract_id) AS contract_id,
         COALESCE(v.chunk_index, t.chunk_index) AS chunk_index,
         COALESCE(v.content, t.content) AS content,
         COALESCE(1.0/(60+v.v_rank), 0) + COALESCE(1.0/(60+t.t_rank), 0) AS rrf_score,
         COALESCE(v.v_sim, 0) AS v_sim,
         COALESCE(t.t_sim, 0) AS t_sim
  FROM v FULL OUTER JOIN t ON v.contract_id = t.contract_id AND v.chunk_index = t.chunk_index
  WHERE COALESCE(v.contract_id, t.contract_id) IS NOT NULL
),
contract_ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY contract_id ORDER BY rrf_score DESC) AS in_contract_rank
  FROM fused
),
best_per_contract AS (
  SELECT contract_id, chunk_index, content, rrf_score, v_sim, t_sim
  FROM contract_ranked
  WHERE in_contract_rank = 1
  ORDER BY rrf_score DESC
  LIMIT $2::int
),
joined AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.doc_no, c.file_name, c.file_type, c.category, c.status, c.source,
         c.size_bytes, c.chunk_count, c.line_user_id, c.uploaded_at, c.updated_at, c.error_message,
         b.chunk_index AS top_chunk_index, b.content AS top_chunk_content,
         b.rrf_score AS similarity, b.v_sim AS vector_sim, b.t_sim AS keyword_sim
  FROM best_per_contract b
  JOIN law.contracts c ON c.id = b.contract_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(
  (SELECT json_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'mode', 'semantic',
    'query', $3::text,
    'count', (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM joined),
    'data', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(j) ORDER BY similarity DESC) FROM joined j), '[]'::json)
  )::text),
  json_build_object('ok', true, 'mode', 'semantic', 'query', $3::text, 'count', 0, 'data', '[]'::json)::text
) AS result_json
